answer.text: Even insider information is in prices — no one can consistently outperform

explanation.text: The Logic: Strong-form EMH says prices reflect historical, public, and insider information, and contends no investor group should be able to earn above-average risk-adjusted returns consistently. The Trap: Strong-form is the most stringent form of EMH; weak-form and semi-strong forms reflect narrower information sets. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.236.
